t: The Magnusson P15P Laser Distance Measurer provides rapid and precise measurements for various indoor tasks. This compact digital tool is ideal for tradespeople such as builders, fitters, and surveyors requiring quick and accurate readings for room dimensions or material estimates. It offers a working range of 0-30 metres with an accuracy of 3mm/m, calculating distances efficiently. Featuring simple one-button control and an automatic power-off function after two minutes, it ensures ease of use and battery conservation. Its lightweight design includes a belt clip for convenient portability on site.
b: One Button Control for Simple Operation
